component.name: Oscilline
component.summary: Rhythm runs on a vector ribbon

description.p: Oscilline is a rhythm game drawn in white vector lines. A figure runs along a ribbon, and you block, loop, wave, and pit past obstacles in time with the music. Clear streaks evolve the figure; misses wear it down.

Play My Music charts any WAV, FLAC, or MP3 file into a course at three difficulties. With a disc image you own of the original 1999 PlayStation game, Oscilline also plays that disc's courses and audio. No game data is included: the disc courses need your own disc image, chosen with Load Disc.
Oscilline is an unofficial project and is not affiliated with the original game's publisher or developer.
